title: Going from Place to Place
editorial: Within CDMX, you can either walk or take an Uber.

To get from CDMX to Chichen-itza, you need to first take a 2.5-hour flight to Merida. We recommend flying into Merida the night prior to your Chichen-itza tour because you want to catch the 7:00 AM bus to beat the heat. The bus itself takes 2 hours.
From Chichen-itza to Bacalar is another bus ride, this one takes 4.5 hours. You only need half a day for the pyramids and cenote, so can catch a late evening bus.
To get back to CDMX from Bacalar, you can take a 2-hour flight from Chetumal. Be sure to book a cab in advance to go from Bacalar to Chetumal as Uber is unreliable in the area.
